subject: ddl: detect tidb version to determine job version to use, add scripts to run V1 separately (#56242)
summary: Reviewed f0a870f^1..f0a870f (DDL/add-index/infoschema/metadata scope). `ddl.Start()` now selects DDL job args version by parsing TiDB instance versions from `infosync.GetAllServerInfo` (using fixed `mysql.VersionSeparator`), and retries periodically until all instances are >= 8.4.0 before switching `model.jobVerInUse` to v2. Confirmed `jobVerInUse` is atomic, v2-enabled job creators already pair `Version: model.GetJobVerInUse()` with v2-capable `model.*Args` + handler decode paths, and non-migrated jobs remain effectively pinned to v1. No plausible remaining Blocker/High correctness/compatibility/concurrency issues found in the touched DDL metadata/state-machine paths.
